R7BL-bear-drive-0002.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R7BL-bear-drive-0002.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: Burn from 2023 (fire G90288), right here: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
SW facing slope, 10 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Unnamed wetland 60 m SW: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

plan: Drive: from Northern Rockies Regional Municipality, about 193 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).

Walk: 150 m SW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-55, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
